'''Syren-fiber''' was a material used by [[Lowbacca]] to create a [[Belt/Legends|belt]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> The fibers were taken from the deadly [[Syren plant/Legends|syren plant]] native to Lowbacca's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Heirs" />
